ui.support_signatures.add_to_existing_of: Other municipalities of this association already belong to "{office}". Assign this municipality there too?
ui.support_signatures.archive_intro: Archived collections disappear from the start page and the list; their numbers are kept.
ui.support_signatures.contact_email: Contact email for questions about the collection
ui.support_signatures.contact_email_hint: Shown together with the collection, e.g. on the start page.
ui.support_signatures.deadline_hint: Enter a whole-day deadline as 00:00 of the following day.
ui.support_signatures.form_intro: The blank form to print; members can download it from the start page.
ui.support_signatures.help_certify: If you like, have your right to vote confirmed by the municipality of your main residence first and send the form to us afterwards. That saves us a trip but is not required.
ui.support_signatures.help_fill: Fill in every field above the note “Nicht von der unterzeichnenden Person auszufüllen” and sign.
ui.support_signatures.help_print: Download the form and print it.
ui.support_signatures.help_what: Parties that are not already represented in parliament may only take part in an election if enough eligible voters support their nomination with their signature. The signature says nothing about whom you vote for later; it only makes sure the Pirate Party is on the ballot.
ui.support_signatures.help_who: Anyone eligible to vote can sign, membership is not needed. For each election you may support only one nomination of the same kind.
ui.support_signatures.intake_intro: Find the municipality by postcode or name, enter the number and save; the search is then ready for the next batch.
ui.support_signatures.list_intro: Collections of support signatures: only counts, no forms and no data of the signers.
ui.support_signatures.member_notice_hint: Shown on the collection's page, e.g. collection dates or info stands. Markdown.
ui.support_signatures.member_page_hint: Only forms whose voting right is certified count.
ui.support_signatures.name: Name
ui.support_signatures.new_office_intro: Name and municipalities are suggested from the municipality directory; please enter the address once, it then applies to all collections.
ui.support_signatures.no_names_hint: Please do not enter names or addresses; the UU assistant only stores counts.
ui.support_signatures.nothing_waiting: No forms are waiting to be sent right now.
ui.support_signatures.office_has_shipmen: Shipments were sent to this office
ui.support_signatures.offices_intro: The offices that certify the voting rights, with their address; in Lower Saxony a Samtgemeinde certifies for its member municipalities. The address book applies to all collections.
ui.support_signatures.overdue_days_hint: After this many days without a full return a shipment counts as overdue.
ui.support_signatures.plan_intro: Every selected office gets one shipment with all waiting forms of its municipalities. A shipment only counts as sent once it is confirmed.
ui.support_signatures.postal_address_war: Everyone who can see the collection sees this address: every visitor for “Public”, everyone signed in for “Members”. If at all possible, do not enter a private address; use e.g. the office or a post box.
ui.support_signatures.prepared_intro: Print the cover letters, enclose the forms, send them and then confirm them as sent.
ui.support_signatures.visibility_hint: Public: every visitor sees the collection on the start page and can download the form. Members: only people who are signed in. Internal: only those who manage the collection.
error.support_signatures.intake.not_foun: This intake was deleted in the meantime.
error.support_signatures.return.empty_li: Every line needs at least one certified or rejected form.
ui.home.features_intro: Among other things, Quartermaster currently offers:
ui.home.feature_membership: Online membership applications and dues selection, processed by the board
ui.home.feature_motions: Motion portal for party conventions: submit motions, collect supporters, motion committee, mirroring to the wiki and forum
ui.home.feature_meetings: Board meetings with agenda and votes
ui.home.feature_expenses: Expense and travel expense reimbursement with receipts and travel expense rules per chapter
ui.home.features_for_chapters: Every chapter may use Quartermaster. If yours would like to, please contact the Bundes IT:
ui.home.sign_in_intro: Many of Quartermaster's features are only available after signing in. If you are a member of the Pirate Party, simply sign in with your Piratenlogin.
ui.home.sign_in_join: Not a member yet? We would be glad to hear from you, and every helping hand is welcome. The way to the membership application is right next to this.
